Container.Name: WatchMyMedia
Container.Overview: Your movies and TV shows, with live TV and recording from an HDHomeRun tuner, on every screen in the house. One container holds the server and the web app; there are apps for Android, Android TV, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, and you can cast to Chromecast and Google TV. Converts video on your Intel, AMD or NVIDIA GPU.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: media server live tv dvr hdhomerun chromecast
Container.Requires: Intel or AMD GPU: keep the /dev/dri device below (remove it if this server has no /dev/dri). NVIDIA: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (Advanced View) and put your GPU's UUID in NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Open the WebUI once the container is running to finish setup.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The web app and API. With Host networking this is the port the server listens on.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, settings, artwork, seek thumbnails and backups. Keep it on a cache pool.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movies folder, read-only. Becomes a library on first start if it holds anything; more folders are added in Settings.

Config.Name: TV Shows
Config.Description: Your TV folder, read-only. Point it at an empty folder if you have no TV shows.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where Live TV recordings go, chosen in Settings, Live TV, Recordings. Remove it if you have no tuner.

Config.Name: Transcode
Config.Description: Converted video while it plays. To use RAM instead, remove this and add --mount type=tmpfs,destination=/transcode,tmpfs-size=4g to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user the server runs as (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions of files the server writes.

Config.Name: Intel or AMD GPU
Config.Description: Hardware video conversion with an Intel or AMD GPU. Remove this if the server has no /dev/dri.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: the GPU's UUID from Plugins, Nvidia Driver, or all. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.
